item.description:
🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:
• 2 com severidade Crítica
• 9 com severidade Alta
• 13 novas CVEs
• 5 novos advisories/exploits

────────────────────────────────────
Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-81472 - ESX
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.2
Resumo:
Dell iDRAC Service Module (iSM) for Windows, Dell iDRAC Service Module (iSM) for Linux, and Dell iDRAC Service Module (iSM) for ESXi, versions prior to 6.1.1.0, contains an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability. A high privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of privileges.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-81472
 
🚨 CVE-2026-77055 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
boneIO black_debian_images gives the boneio service account excessive privileges, including full passwordless sudo access and membership in the docker group. A local attacker who compromises the boneio user can use these privileges to escalate to root. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: the image removes the sudoers rule and the docker group membership when it is sealed, and devices already in the field have both...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77055
 
🚨 CVE-2026-16491 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Grafana’s RBAC service ignored the requested folder when checking whether a user was a folder administrator for deleted dashboard listings. A user with dashboard permission-management rights on any folder could therefore be treated as an administrator of every folder. This could expose deleted dashboard items from folders where the user lacked administrative access. The fix requires permission on the specified folder...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-16491
 
📰 New Whitepaper: Architecting a Governed, Multi-Tenant Private AI Cloud with VCF 9
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Multi-Tenancy Is the Engine of the Modern Private AI Cloud The private cloud is undergoing a profound transformation. Today’s enterprise IT organizations are tasked with supporting diverse, resource-intensive workloads, spanning AI, Kubernetes / containers, and virtual machines, on shared infrastructure. Simultaneously, they must enforce strict isolation between business divisions, developers, or external clients.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/10/28/new-whitepaper-architecting-a-governed-multi-tenant-private-ai-cloud-with-vcf-9/
 
📰 From Infrastructure to Agents: A Hands-on Guide to Secure Private AI with Broadcom – Part 4
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Part 4 of 4: Governing the Agentic Loop – Bringing Platform as a Service and Governed Agentic Loop with Tanzu and AgentMinder An AI agent needs more than a model. It needs instructions and skills, memory to retain context, and tools that let it interact with the systems around it.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/10/28/from-infrastructure-to-agents-a-hands-on-guide-to-secure-private-ai-with-broadcom-part-4/
 
📰 導入事例：アイテック阪急阪神様
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
阪急阪神東宝グループにおけるIT分野を担うシステムインテグレーターとして、鉄道の運行管理や医療システムなど社会基盤を支えるソリューションを提供するアイテック阪急阪神株式会社様。本日はVMware®の伴走支援サービス（TAM/CES）を活用した事例をご紹介いたします。 同社では10年以上にわたりVMware vSphere®で仮想基盤を運用し、事業拡大とともに規模を拡張されてきました。しかし、ハードウェア更改を契機とした基盤統合にあたり、年間約1,400件にも及ぶ膨大な脆弱性情報の精査が追いつかず、客観的なベストプラクティスが不明なまま運用が属人化してしまうという課題に直面していました。この「情報過多による負担」と「少人数運用の限界」を打破したのが、弊社VMwareのTAM（Technical Adoption Manager）およびCES（Consulting Expert Service）による伴走支援です。 脆弱性情報の精査...
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/vmware-japan/2026/10/customer-case-studies_itec.html

Segurança - Acronis / Axur / Check Point / Harmony SASE / Qualys / SentinelOne

🚨 Adobe Fixes 8 Critical Campaign Classic Flaws Allowing Code Execution and Security Bypass
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.9
Resumo:
Adobe has released patches to address multiple critical security flaws in Campaign Classic that, if successfully exploited, could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. The list of eight vulnerabilities is as follows - CVE-2026-104351 (CVSS score: 9.9) - A code injection vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/adobe-fixes-8-critical-campaign-classic.html
 
🚨 Hackers Target Critical Oracle E-Business Suite RCE Flaw Days After Security Patch
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
Threat actors are beginning to probe for a newly patched critical vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), according to threat intelligence firm Defused Cyber. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-101767 (CVSS score: 9.8) in the Oracle Application Object Library of Oracle E-Business Suite. It was patched by Oracle last week as part of its Critical Patch Update.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-target-critical-oracle-e.html
 
🚨 ShinyHunters-Exploited Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Turns Out to Be Three Chained Flaws
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The critical Oracle PeopleSoft bug that ShinyHunters has exploited since May is not one flaw but three chained together, the researchers who reported it said this week. Oracle patched all three under a single identifier, CVE-2026-35273, in June. Its root is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) that reaches an internal management interface because PeopleSoft trusts its own loopback address
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/shinyhunters-exploited-oracle.html
 
🚨 CVE-2025-30414 - Acronis
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Acronis
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.1
Resumo:
Local privilege escalation due to improper authentication. The following products are affected: Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud Agent (Windows) before build 42569, Acronis Cyber Protect 17 (Windows) before build 42587.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-30414
 
🚨 CVE-2026-99091 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: MGMT: Fix status of pending commands flushed on power off cmd_complete_rsp() receives a struct cmd_lookup and, for a pending command that has no cmd_complete callback, falls through to cmd_status_rsp(cmd, data). cmd_status_rsp() reads data as a u8 *, so the status sent comes from the first byte of match->sk's representation, not from match...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-99091
 
🚨 CVE-2026-87097 - Acronis
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Acronis
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.3
Resumo:
Sensitive information disclosure due to insufficiently protected credentials. The following products are affected: Acronis Cyber Protect 17 (Linux, Windows) before build 42587.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-87097
 
💣 Even after PHP2Shell, blast radius matters more than a CVSS score
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
PHP2Shell shows how quickly attackers can exploit critical vulnerabilities, often before organizations have time to patch. Token Security explains why limiting the access of service accounts, API keys, and AI agents is just as important as fixing vulnerabilities to reduce the damage from a breach.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/even-after-php2shell-blast-radius-matters-more-than-a-cvss-score/
 
💣 CISA warns of hackers now exploiting critical Node2Shell flaw
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
On Tuesday, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) confirmed that hackers have begun exploiting a critical Brotli vulnerability known as Node2Shell, Broccoli2Shell, and HTTP2Shell.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-warns-of-hackers-now-exploiting-critical-node2shell-flaw/
 
💣 InfraTrust report warns of exploited flaws in critical network infrastructure
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities across critical network infrastructure, and PHP flaws known as "PHP2Shell" put the web management interfaces of firewalls, VPNs, application delivery controllers, and other appliances at risk.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/infratrust-report-warns-of-exploited-flaws-in-critical-network-infrastructure/
 
💣 China-Linked Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell to Root Firewalls
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: SecurityWeek
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The attackers chained PHP2Shell and Fragnesia exploits and hacked two servers of a US government-affiliated organization.
Link: https://www.securityweek.com/china-linked-hackers-exploit-php2shell-to-root-firewalls/

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 CVE-2026-106076 - Office
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Office
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A vulnerability allowing an authenticated organization-transfer peer to inject SQL into the configuration database of the source Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server, leading to cross-tenant read and write of configuration data and remote code execution as the PostgreSQL service account.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-106076
 
🚨 CVE-2026-112344 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.8
Resumo:
before 8.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers with a symbolic link placed inside a user's home folder to access files outside the virtual filesystem root because confinement is enforced only against the requested path and not the on-disk destination of the link. Attackers can leverage a symlink or, on Windows, a directory junction that points outside the jail to read or access restricted...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112344
 
🚨 CVE-2025-64394 - Office
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Office
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A vulnerability allowing a low-privileged local user to write arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges during the installation of Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365, which can lead to privilege escalation or denial of service.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-64394
 
🚨 CVE-2026-103312 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Payment Integration Wompi WordPress plugin through 4.0.1 does not verify the authenticity of incoming payment notifications on a stock install, because the callback's checksum is keyed on a merchant secret that is empty until it is manually configured, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to forge a notification and mark an arbitrary order as paid.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-103312
